macros.name: address
macros.doc: \address{<text>} Sets the contact address that appears in the cover page address block.

macros.name: agent
macros.doc: \agent{<text>} Sets the agent information for the cover page.

macros.name: coverpage
macros.doc: Produce a standard cover page with title, author, and contact information.

macros.name: dialbreak
macros.doc: \dialbreak[〈paren〉]{〈CHARACTER〉} Ends the current dialogue environment with a “(MORE)” marker, starts a new page, and opens a new dialogue block for the same character, labelled with a continuation marker (typically “(CONT’D)” or its translation).

macros.name: fadein
macros.doc: \fadein Inserts the language-specific “FADE IN:” label followed by a vertical skip.

macros.name: fadeout
macros.doc: \fadeout Inserts the language-specific “FADE OUT:” label (or its equivalent), usually aligned to the right in the standard transition position.

macros.name: flashback
macros.doc: \flashback Inserts a “FLASHBACK TO:” label (or equivalent), again in the standard transition position.

macros.name: intercut
macros.doc: \intercut Inserts an “INTERCUT WITH:” label, usually flush right, to indicate intercutting between locations.

macros.name: intextslug
macros.doc: \intextslug[〈qualifier〉]{〈location〉} Combined interior/exterior slugline (“INT./EXT.”), useful for scenes that move between inside and outside.

macros.name: nicholl
macros.doc: \nicholl Produces a simpler title page variant with just the title centered on the page and no address block.

macros.name: realauthor
macros.doc: \realauthor{<name>} Sets the real author name, as printed in the address block on the cover when \author refers to a pseudonym.

macros.name: theend
macros.doc: \theend Typesets the language-specific “THE END” (or equivalent) centered on the page.

macros.name: titbreak
macros.doc: \titbreak can be used to mark a break to the next page while indicating that the title continues.

envs.name: dialogue
envs.doc: Typesets character name and dialogue in the standard screenplay layout.
